intro: Today's briefing covers key political developments including the upcoming Pashinyan-Putin talks and the Yerevan municipality's use of private assets, alongside economic cooperation with the UAE and domestic social initiatives.

topics.title: Pashinyan and Putin to discuss security and Russian military base
topics.text: The Kremlin confirmed that Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan and Russian President Vladimir Putin will hold talks focusing on security issues and the status of the Russian military base in Armenia. A Kremlin spokesperson described the base as a "very important element" of regional stability, while noting that Armenia's orientation toward the EU and its desire to remain in the EAEU are viewed as incompatible.

topics.title: Yerevan municipality uses Tsarukyan-owned assets without custody agreement
topics.text: Investigations by CivilNet and RFE/RL reveal that the Yerevan municipality is utilizing private assets belonging to Prosperous Armenia Party leader Gagik Tsarukyan without a formal custody agreement. The reports highlight a lack of legal documentation governing the use of these properties by the city administration.

topics.title: Armenia and UAE expand bilateral cooperation
topics.text: Armenian Deputy Foreign Minister met with the UAE Minister of State for Foreign Affairs to discuss the bilateral agenda. Separately, officials in Abu Dhabi discussed prospects for further cooperation, signaling a deepening of ties between the two nations.

sources.title: Armenian deputy foreign minister discusses bilateral agenda with UAE minister of state for foreign affairs
Armenia and UAE discuss prospects for further cooperation at Abu Dhabi meeting

topics.title: Azerbaijan expands list of goods supplied to Armenia
topics.text: Azerbaijani Foreign Minister Jeyhun Bayramov stated that Baku is expanding the list of goods being supplied to Armenia. A separate report noted that goods worth $23.7 million were exported from Azerbaijan to Armenia between January and October, raising questions about the trade operators involved.

sources.title: FM Bayramov: Azerbaijan expanding list of goods being supplied to Armenia
Newspaper: Goods worth $23.7M exported from Azerbaijan to Armenia in January-October – who is conducting the trade?

topics.title: Hayastan All-Armenian Fund launches annual fundraising campaign
topics.text: The Hayastan All-Armenian Fund has launched its annual fundraising campaign. The initiative aims to mobilize resources for humanitarian and development projects across Armenia and Artsakh.

sources.title: Hayastan All-Armenian Fund launches annual fundraising campaign

topics.title: Yerevan launches 16 Days of Activism against Gender-Based Violence
topics.text: Armenia's Interior Ministry Educational Complex hosted the national launch of the international "16 Days of Activism against Gender-Based Violence" campaign. The event marks the start of a series of awareness-raising activities running through December 10.

sources.title: Yerevan hosts national launch of 16 Days of Activism against Gender-Based Violence

topics.title: Constitutional Court petition filed challenging parliamentary election results
topics.text: The press secretary for the Prosperous Armenia Party announced that the party has petitioned the Constitutional Court and the European Court of Human Rights (ECHR) to challenge the results of the parliamentary elections. Former President Serzh Sargsyan also voiced disapproval of the proposed draft constitution, warning of dangers to the country.
